female with chief complaints of\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Decreased urine output since - 3 months\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-pedal edema since - 3months.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShortness of breath since - 3 months\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of present illness:\u003C\/b\u003E-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Epatient was apparently asymptomatic 1yr back then she noticed decreased urine output and was diagnosed with heart failure and renal failure and started on conservative management.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThen 3months back she noticed increased Bilateral pedal edema -pitting type, extending till ankles .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eshortness of breath - grade 3(MMRC) insidious onset and progressive.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOrthopnea is present .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of burning micturition, cough, cold, fever.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of past illness: -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EK\/C\/O Hypertension since 30 years, diabetes mellitus since 30 years\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot known case of asthma, :\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBilaterally symmetrical chest\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo visible engorged veins,scars or sinuses on chest.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPalpation :\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ES1 S2 are heard\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EApex beat present at 5th intercostal space lateral to midclavicular line .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAuscultation :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECardiac rate - 100 beats per minute\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo cardiac murmurs
